A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with complete main text, references, and Appendices A–C. Text extraction and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v3 reports original VLA training and evaluation experiments in Sections 4–5 and Appendix B, including simulation results and a 30-trial physical-robot evaluation.

after.justification: v4 retains those original empirical results, including the main generalization experiments, physical-robot evaluation, action-chunking experiments, and articulated-object task.

M1.justification: The OpenVLA-based PPO procedure, shared actor-critic backbone, warm-up, and minimal training epochs are unchanged. Appendix B.5 also retains the same action-chunking adaptation.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training data and pick-and-place generalization scenarios. The sim-to-real evaluation in B.4 and articulated-object task in B.6 are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Figure 3 retains PPO, PPO-ORZ, GRPO, and both DPO iterations. The corresponding main-text and appendix experiments retain the same SFT-versus-RL comparisons.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, demonstration counts, model configurations, training budgets, metrics, and testing procedures match. This includes the 30 real-world trials and the chunk-size-4 setting in Appendix B.5.

E4.justification: The critic-design, warm-up, PPO-epoch, temperature, and LoRA-rank ablations are unchanged, as are the trajectory analyses, rollout case studies, and action-chunking robustness check.

E5.justification: Both retain two-seed Section 4 experiments, three-seed main generalization comparisons and articulated-object results, and the same standard-deviation reporting in Tables 1, 3, and 4.

E6.justification: All result tables, plotted outcomes, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 2 reports identical SFT/RL grasp success rates of 0.10/0.43 and pick-and-place success rates of 0.00/0.27 in both versions.

T1.justification: The POMDP formulation and training objectives in Section 3, along with the PPO, GAE, GRPO, and TPO equations in Appendix A.1, are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark and efficient-PPO contributions, and the same claims of improved semantic and execution generalization with comparable visual robustness.

C2.justification: Explanations of algorithm behavior, broader RL trajectory coverage, corrective execution, and sim-to-real findings are unchanged. The limitations and Appendix C broader-impacts discussion also match.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures, motion-planner and action-filtering details, asset sources, and documented project/checkpoint access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, bibliography, and positioning relative to prior VLA and reinforcement-learning research are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 replaces the affiliation list with three specific Tsinghua University units, updates affiliation superscripts and contact footnotes, and adds Beijing Zhongguancun Academy Project C20250301 to the acknowledgements. Research prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The title page reformats author names into two rows, expands affiliations, and moves email addresses into footnotes. The longer acknowledgement slightly reflows page 10. Figures and tables retain their content and design; the other 22 pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v4 updates affiliation and funding information with limited layout adjustments. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and appendices remain unchanged, supporting no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
